quests.name: A Parcel for the General Store Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Yarengate to the general store keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the general store keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Staff Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the staff shop keeper of Yarengate and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the staff shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Yarengate Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Yarengate Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Yarengate Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Giant Spiders
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the giant spider near Yarengate thinned out.
intro: The giant spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Yarengate and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Oak Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Yarengate has run out of oak logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 21 oak logs and nobody in Yarengate has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Yarengate to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the magic shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the archery shop keeper of Yarengate and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the archery shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The clothes shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Yarengate Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Yarengate and bring back maple logs.
intro: The wilds around Yarengate need a firm hand. Start with 13 snake outside the walls, then 21 giant spider down in Yarengate Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 26 maple logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Yarengate for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the armour shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.

quests.name: Sweeping the Yarengate Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Yarengate Sewers and tell the realtor.
intro: Yarengate Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the realtor know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Yarengate owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Yarengate Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Eloreach
quests.summary: Gather coal for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Eloreach.
intro: I have an order from Eloreach and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 26 coal, then take the packed shipment to the sword shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Yarengate.
From Yarengate? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

player: A sealed note, from the staff shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Yarengate Sewers (Clothes Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Yarengate Sewers and tell the food shop keeper.
intro: Yarengate Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the food shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Yarengate owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Yarengate Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Eloreach (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather raw salmon for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Eloreach.
intro: I have an order from Eloreach and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw salmon, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Yarengate.
From Yarengate? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Yarengate
quests.summary: Find what rules Yarengate Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Yarengate Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the sword shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Yarengate is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Yarengate Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Yarengate for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the general store keeper, fight your way through 31 spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 16 bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Yarengate: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Yarengate Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Yarengate and Eloreach.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Eloreach. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 snake near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the food shop keeper underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Yarengate.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Eloreach is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Yarengate has not had news this good in years.
